# SheenBidi

Unmodified `Source/`, `Headers/` and `LICENSE` from SheenBidi **2.9.0**:

https://github.com/Tehreer/SheenBidi/tree/v2.9.0

Source archive: https://codeload.github.com/Tehreer/SheenBidi/tar.gz/refs/tags/v2.9.0

Archive SHA-256: `e90ae142c6fc8b94366f3526f84b349a2c10137f87093db402fe51f6eace6d13`.

`tools/build_text.py` builds the upstream `Source/SheenBidi.c` unity source with
`SB_CONFIG_UNITY`. It provides Unicode bidirectional ordering for mixed Arabic,
Latin and numeric text using only C library allocation and memory functions.

License: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` and the notices retained in the sources.
